proof_attempt_summary: Five proposal revisions developed a reset-certified transfer compiler, compatible-law tangent formulation, Perron sensitivity expansion, and explicit hidden-confounded examples. The final root change corrected the front-door arithmetic and promoted an algebraic generic-nonvanishing theorem, but the chosen binary family was saturated, so its tangent reduced to ordinary row-sum constraints and the matrix-ball comparison had no established causal or decision consequence. A future re-raise would need a genuinely constrained multistate family with an operational robustness implication; that is a new research program rather than a bounded repair.
tldr: On the named open 14-parameter binary conditional-front-door family, what does a compatible observed-cell perturbation do to repeated-policy causal survival? The proposed exact theorem identifies the entire compatible tangent, gives an algebraic Perron-derivative zero test, proves positive linear survival sensitivity throughout the open region, and proves an open-neighborhood separation from four directly perturbed transition and killed-kernel input models. Stochastic endpoints and shared-transfer survivor ratios have bounded sensitivity. The reset compiler and generic spectral/LP formulas support this family result; a coupled two-track example tests a constrained extension.
gap: Direct constrained-transition response, finite killed-chain asymptotics, and structured Perron sensitivity already handle a supplied matrix perturbation set. The unresolved causal step is to derive the admissible matrix velocities from a hidden-confounded compatible observed law and prove a family-level classification rather than one isolated numerical contrast.
fill: Prove the family theorem: exact response-type compatibility, row-sum tangent, adjoint annihilator criterion and polynomial locus, everywhere-positive proper-survival slope, universal endpoint and shared-transfer zeros, and robust separation of causally induced versus four direct matrix-input balls. The two-track response face remains corroboration.
